rootCause: setOwner() is missing the onlyOwner modifier, so any address can take ownership of the vault and then call the correctly guarded destroy(), which selfdestructs to owner and force-sends the full escrow balance.

steps.title: Victim funds the escrow
steps.description: The victim deposits 60 ETH. The vault records balances[victim] and the owner is the deployer.

steps.title: Ownership taken through the unguarded setter
steps.description: setOwner() was deployed without the onlyOwner modifier. The attacker calls it and slot 0 (owner) is rewritten from the victim to the attacker.

steps.title: destroy() force-sends the escrow to the new owner
steps.description: destroy() is properly guarded by onlyOwner, but the attacker is now the owner. selfdestruct(payable(owner)) pushes the full 60 ETH balance to the attacker.
